title: Google Research NoRML: No-Reward Meta-Learning with Learned Advantage Functions & Weight Offsets
author: repo-triad-forge

edges.description: Subproject norml in snapshot google-research-master (archive snapshot, non-git); arXiv:1903.01063
Complements continuous-control robustness shifts with test-time no-reward dynamics adaptation

claims.assertion: MAMLReinforcementLearning adapts policies under dynamics shifts without test-time rewards by computing inner advantages from a meta-learned advantage network over [s_{t+1}, s_t, a_t] (learn_advantage_function_inner) and applying a meta-learned parameter offset test_weights = theta - a * grad + e (learn_offset), while optimizing the outer meta-objective with clipped PPO (ppo_clip_value).

Declarative {ENV}_{ALG} config registry (e.g. MOVE_POINT_ROTATE_MAML with task_env_modifiers, per-tensor learn_inner_lr_tensor, learn_offset, ppo_clip_value=0.2) systematically isolates DR, MAML, MAML_OFFSET, MAML_LAF, and NORML ablations.

distilled_learning: Enable test-time reinforcement-learning adaptation without external reward signals by meta-learning both an inner-loop advantage estimator conditioned on state transitions (s_t, a_t, s_{t+1}) and a learned policy parameter adaptation offset under clipped PPO outer training.
